text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in Norwegian papers this morning:
- Norway's power shortage is over, the water reservoirs are full and the country is now exporting electricity again.
- Critics think that the chief public prosecutor has too much power. They say it is wrong that one person has such a big influence on the entire legal system of Norway.
- The low unemployment rate has resulted in a shortage of workers in several sectors, including in the furniture manufacturing industry.
- The Oslo Stock Exchange Total index soared to a new all-time high stimulated by falling U.S. interest rates and the rising Dow Jones index.
- The Telenor state telecommunications group is planning to invest two billion crowns in new office space in the next few years.
- Den norske Bank (DnB) and other banks are now increasing the interest rate for clients as a result of rising money market rates.
